name: blastradius
description: Dependency-graph-based selective CI testing system for monorepos

scripts.dashboard: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let p=path.join(__dirname, req.url==='/'?'dashboard/index.html':req.url); if(!fs.existsSync(p)) p=path.join(__dirname,'dashboard',req.url); if(fs.existsSync(p)){ res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type': p.endsWith('.html')?'text/html':p.endsWith('.json')?'application/json':p.endsWith('.css')?'text/css':'application/javascript'}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } }).listen(3000,()=>console.log('Dashboard running at http://localhost:3000/dashboard/index.html'));"
